description: MUTATES place_visits for map/history digs (Uber dropoff, address evidence). Required: place (or place_id) + arrived_at/date. arrived_at: a clock time with offset when the user gave a time or part of day (afternoon → 15:00 local); YYYY-MM-DD when only the day is known — the visit is then stored with no clock time and the receipt says "time not specified". arrival_time_precision: approximate when the clock time reads a part of day (evening → 19:00), so readers show "~19:00"; exact (default) only for a time the user gave. Optional: departed_at, source (a provenance tag: uber|mcp|manual|import, not a note), evidence_expense_id (idempotent), city/country/address. Add-only: a repeat on the same day returns the stored visit (duplicate: true, retained, mismatch) and never changes it. Prefer this over stuffing streets only into expenses. ($0.10; API key required)

arrival_time_precision.description: approximate when arrived_at reads a part of day the user gave (morning, afternoon, evening → 09:00/15:00/19:00); exact (default) when the user gave the clock time. Ignored for a date-only arrival.

arrived_at.description: ISO 8601 with offset (2026-10-21T15:00:00+08:00) when the user gave a time or part of day (morning 09:00, afternoon 15:00, evening 19:00, local); a clock time without an offset is wall time in the account timezone; YYYY-MM-DD when only the day is known (time not specified).

date.description: Alias for arrived_at (YYYY-MM-DD: the day only, time not specified)

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

source.description: Provenance tag (uber, mcp, manual, import, gmail:uber-<id>), not a note.

conflict.description: Add-only write: an open visit to the place from an earlier day was retained (kind: open_visit_retained, visit_id, note); this visit was stored closed at its own arrival.

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

retained.description: On a duplicate: the stored visit kept as is (visit_id, visit_date, arrived_at, departed_at, arrival_time_specified, arrival_time_approximate).

visit.description: Confirmed same-day outing with visit_date and evidence_refs. A typed place_visits row is primary and carries visit_id (= id); linked event/GPS evidence is reconciled without increasing the count.
